independence: Exclude entire conversations sharing seed/category id, title, theme, narrative, normalized question or >=160-char turn/64-word shingle selected by 32-window winnowing (shared95-word sequence guaranteed) with observed BEAM100K or LongMemEval-S; group remaining shared signatures as dependent components. No semantic/pretraining independence assertion.
selection: One question per category per eligible conversation by SHA256 heldout-answer-v1 + observable qid; deterministic hash order; no answer/outcome selection; 300-350 questions, >=30 components; otherwise stop before retrieval/inference and seek a new corpus GO.
primary: Question-weighted paired binary answer correctness C4 minus same-arm BM25; include abstention and all 10 categories; 10000 whole-conversation/dependence-component bootstrap samples, seed 20261011, percentile CI95; no partial-denominator result.
criterion: Complete denominator, zero unresolved/blocked call, >=30 independent components, lower bound CI95(delta accuracy) > 0. Missing CI fails; no category-specific selection, no optional significance stopping.
claim: Only end-to-end C4 superiority over this reproduced BM25 on audited, project-unobserved BEAM500K under the fixed Codex reader/judge if the criterion passes. NOT official GPT-4o judgment, published-score comparability, competitor ranking or top 1. Model slug fixed but remote snapshot unverified; CI is sampling uncertainty, not judge validity.
models: Reader gpt-5.6-luna low; judge gpt-6-astra high; one isolated exec per task, anonymous arm, ChatGPT login only, no API/key/fallback; prompts unchanged from descriptive pilot.
capture: Only chat/content/observable time_anchor, quote chunks1024; no question/rubric/reference/category/seed/narrative into ingestion. Top10, 12000 context bytes, same quote corpus for both arms. No oracle annotations, inferred recency or supersession tuning. Synthetic capture timestamp2000-01-01; recency disabled; dedup cosine1.01 confinement and exact-text dedup only, as in the pilot; production encoder profile matches, not every live ingestion policy.
encoder: Qualified 4.0.3 source identical to copy proof; Granite97m cached revision835ad14087e140460703cf0fae09f97d469d65c2; auto must resolve MPS, native parameters, batch32, max_seq512, actual device/dtypes/runtime attested before capture; no CPU fallback/download.
resume: Sequential batch <=40 calls, stop after quota reject; next batch/day starts only with explicit operator --resume and same plan/source/CLI/model/encoder/context hashes. Reuse completed reader/judge receipts, never replay a pending/uncertain/tool/error/schema/time/guard call. Only pre-generation usage-limit event without item/completed-turn is quota-resumable; unknown tokens remain unknown. Additional 200 quota attempts shared globally, not per day.
